name: global-law
description: The legislation of 200+ countries as a dated history: read any provision as it stood on any date, see which law changed it and when, compare dates, search a country's law, and check legal citations. Every answer links the official publisher's text. Hosted, read-only remote server: no account, no API key, no auth.

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: List every jurisdiction and body of law in the tree, with how far each record reaches and an example path. Start here.

tools.name: find_provision
tools.description: Find the file path of a provision by its number ("1182", "Art. 16a", "reg 13") or words from its heading ("debtor", "Asylrecht"). Also finds an act by its name ("Data Protection Act 2018": its folder) and a court decision by its docket number or citation ("1 BvR 1547/19", "410 U.S. 113").

tools.name: read_law
tools.description: The text of a provision as it was in force on a date, with the law that last changed it, the next change, its history in brief, and any limit of the record that applies. Several provisions in one answer: give paths, or a folder (an act) as path.

tools.name: world_on_date
tools.description: What every jurisdiction in the tree looked like on one date: the last change in force in each, and the next.

tools.name: who_wrote
tools.description: Which law wrote each word (or each line) of a provision as it stood on a date, with a count of words per law.

tools.name: compare_dates
tools.description: How a provision changed between two dates: a word-level diff of its text on date_a and its text on date_b, and the laws that took effect after date_a, up to and including date_b.

tools.name: provision_history
tools.description: Every law that changed a provision, oldest first, with its in-force, enacted or made, and published dates.

tools.name: laws_between
tools.description: Every law that took effect between two dates, both days included, across all jurisdictions or one, in the order they took effect.

tools.name: search_law
tools.description: Search the text of all the law in force on a date, across every jurisdiction or one. Plain text by default.

tools.name: changes_between
tools.description: Every provision whose text on date_b differs from its text on date_a, in every jurisdiction or one, with the laws that took effect after date_a, up to and including date_b.

tools.name: list_provisions
tools.description: Browse a corpus: the provision files under a corpus or folder (for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11), with headings, as in force on a date. For a folder of acts or instruments, by_folder gives one row each with its title and last change; a partial name lists the folders that start with it (malta/national/acts/sl/586. for every instrument made under Cap. 586).

tools.name: search_changes
tools.description: Search the record of changes (each commit message: the law, its dates, what it did) rather than the text of the law. For example "temporary", "COVID", "Bundesrat". With start and end, the changes in force from start to end, both days included.

tools.name: resolve_citations
tools.description: Read every citation in a piece of text (a brief, a judgment, an email) and resolve each to its provision, with its state on a date: in force or not, the law that last changed it, and the next change.

tools.name: check_precedent
tools.description: The judgments the record holds for a provision, each checked: is the text the court applied still the text in force (today, or on a date), and if not, which laws changed it and how? Also checks any one decision by the day it was decided (decided).

tools.name: what_else_changes
tools.description: Which provisions rely on, cite or use the definitions of this one, on a date: those that cite it, and those that use a term it defines (for example the provisions that use "debtor in possession"), with the definition's scope ("In this subchapter"). Use it before a text search when asked what depends on a provision or its definitions; a change to this provision can change what they mean.

tools.name: phrase_history
tools.description: When words came into the law and when they left it, at any date and in every jurisdiction: each change whose added or removed text contains them. Use it for things no longer in force (for example "COVID" in the Grundgesetz).

tools.name: applies_to_case
tools.description: For a case commenced on one date, which later changes to a provision reach it (from any scope the record holds, such as "cases commenced on or after"), and the text that applies to it.

tools.name: law_details
tools.description: The full record of a law's change: its commit message with every trailer (enacted, in force, published, sources, scope), the provisions it changed, and what it did to each one's words (a word diff, or "layout only", or "text moved between provisions"). One call answers "what did this law change"; no need to compare each provision.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. No account, API key or sign-in is needed.

examples.title: Law on a date
examples.description: Read a provision as it stood on a past date
examples.prompt: What did 11 U.S.C. 1182 say on 1 January 2021, and which law last changed it?

examples.title: Compare dates
examples.description: See how a provision changed between two dates
examples.prompt: How did Article 16a of the German Grundgesetz change between 1990 and 2000?

examples.title: Check citations
examples.description: Resolve the citations in a piece of text and check each is in force
examples.prompt: Check every citation in this paragraph and tell me whether each provision is still in force today.
